label: ACTUALITY_AGREEMENT_CONTENT_8: Agreement P a e means P e iff P a
definition: Agreement P a e means P e iff P a. Its diagonal is always true; off-diagonal it compares a fixed actuality with the evaluation world. For example, agreement about whether the SAME candidate exists; this is not claiming that the candidate exists at every world.
note: Analyst formulation for issue #1049. Neither naming/context policy nor metaphysical applicability is defended. SEP Modal Logic §§10/16 is navigation only; attribution deferred. No new modal calculus or reality claim.
